verdict.rationale: Formant documents several official SDKs: an Agent SDK for telemetry ingestion, commands and teleop; a Python Cloud SDK for querying and ingestion; and a GitHub toolkit for building applications on its APIs and RealtimeSDK. That falls well short of the story's multi-language, typed, full-surface coverage. Only Python is explicitly named as a language, and no OpenAPI spec was found that could anchor typed clients. missing for 10: evidence of TypeScript, Go and C++ SDKs, typed interfaces, coverage of the full platform surface (including the Admin API), and independent corroboration.
